title: Named Entity JSON Schema
description: Definition of the output representation of entity processing, before indexing. Named entity mentions are expressed as offline annotations with character offsets relative to content items. The output is a list of JSON documents (JSON Lines), one per content item, containing named entities from the article body and title. The tagset corresponds to impresso-HIPE.

surface.description: The surface form of the named entity mention, as it appears in the text.

lOffset.description: The left character offset of the named entity with respect to the corresponding text element (full text for nes, title for tnes).

rOffset.description: The right character offset of the named entity with respect to the corresponding text element (full text for nes, title for tnes).

confidence_ner.description: Confidence score of the Named Entity Recognition process.

confidence_nel.description: Confidence score of the Named Entity Linking process.

wkpedia_pagename.description: Wikipedia page name, i.e. the last part of the wikipedia URL (e.g.  United_States)

name.description: In case of a person mention, the entity component of type 'name', as defined in the Impresso HIPE NE Annotation guidelines (https://zenodo.org/records/3585750).

title.description: In case of a person mention, the entity component of type 'title', as defined in the Impresso HIPE NE Annotation guidelines (https://zenodo.org/records/3585750).

function.description: In case of a person mention, the entity component of type 'function', as defined in the Impresso HIPE NE Annotation guidelines (https://zenodo.org/records/3585750).

ts.description: Timestamp of creation of the JSON file (e.g. '2024-05-26T09:48:01Z').

model_id.description: Composite model identifier '<NER Model>|<NEL Model>' (each 'name@revision'), e.g. 'impresso-project/ner-hipe2020-mmbert-base-final@8d95f6d|impresso-project/nel-mgenre-multilingual@main'. Order is NER|NEL, matching the entity id's model tail.

prompt_unit.description: Extension. The text unit fed to mGENRE for every mention in this record: 'sentence' (the lingproc sentence containing the mention) or 'window' (the full body/title segment, mention-centered).

nes.description: Named entity mentions extracted from the article body.

tnes.description: Named entity mentions extracted from the article title.
